module: Node "Load Level" (blue color, public icon). Loads a level: levelPath is relative to levels/ (info.json is added automatically). Inputs: flow, levelPath (templates = all levels), model and config (hidden, to spawn a specific vehicle). Output: flow, activated when the level is loaded. State machine: 1 starts the loading (core_levels.startLevel), 2 waits, 3 waits delayBufferFrames then emits onClientPostStartMission/onClientStartMission and reloads the map (map.assureLoad), 4 finished. Node data: preventPlayerSpawning, forceLevelLoad, delayBufferFrames, stopRunningOnClientEndMission, noLoadInEdit, customLoadingScreen.
notes: If the editor is active, it is stopped during loading then reactivated.
In work, self.stopRunningOnClientEndMission (node field) is used as the value of mgr.stopRunningOnClientEndMission, but it is never defined: it is nil.
The config comment says "specific color" while the pin is the vehicle config.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes the state to 1, the flow pin to false and the default data (preventPlayerSpawning=true, forceLevelLoad=true, delayBufferFrames=0, noLoadInEdit=true, customLoadingScreen=false...).

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the state to 1, flow to false and clears mgr.__delayedLoadingScreenFunctions.

postInit.desc: Fills the templates of the levelPath pin with the sorted list from getAllLevelIdentifiers().

onLoadingScreenFadeout.desc: Hook called on the fade-out of the loading screen; goes to state 3 with the frame delay, unless already in state 4.

missionFile.desc: Loaded mission file (used for the log).

work.desc: Advances the state machine. If the requested level is already loaded (and forceLevelLoad is false or the editor is active with noLoadInEdit), goes directly to 4. Otherwise starts core_levels.startLevel (disabling the automatic player spawn according to the data), then finalizes in state 3.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the current state in the node body.
